Tournament Summary

2022 UK Open Final 16 brought together 48 players in 9-Ball at Greater London,England,United Kingdom, with 15 recorded matches.

Joshua Filler won the event ahead of Francisco Sanchez Ruiz.

The strongest matchups by combined player rating included Francisco Sanchez Ruiz vs. Joshua Filler (7-13); David Alcaide vs. Joshua Filler (4-11); Aleksa Pecelj vs. Joshua Filler (10-11).

The biggest upset was Skyler Woodward beating Oliver Szolnoki 11-5 despite a 65 point rating gap.
